_meta.description: World geography generated from the legacy transcription and reconciled, source-backed authoring records.
_meta.schema_notes: Nodes are land/sea tiles. City status (`is_city`) is separate from terrain. Each neighbor entry describes source -> neighbor. `border_terrain` is a string or a list of simultaneous first-round terrains, e.g. ["desert", "mountain"], not inferred from node terrain. `has_river` describes a river route; `river_crossing` is a directional combat crossing. `naval_facilities` and matching `naval_facility_ids` are paired physical instances. Repeated types with distinct IDs are separate facilities; the same ID on two coast edges is one shared facility. Intrinsic facilities use `node_facilities` / `node_facility_ids`. Reviewed direct land narrow crossings have `narrow_crossing`, printed unit capacity in the legacy-named `narrow_crossings`, and `narrow_crossing_sea_zones` for all blocking seas. They are constrained crossings under rule 1.9, not unrestricted land adjacency. `railway_connection` is a reciprocal boolean regardless of the number of drawn tracks; `gauge_change` remains separate. Rule 10.6.2 (p. 67) bombs all railroads on a border together. Damage is mutable game state, not encoded by the static rail presence flag.
warnings: Physical geography is reviewed within recorded field scopes; legacy attributes are not automatically certified.
Uncertain findings and nested fields remain deferred in gw36_manual_map_review.json.
Canada seam rulings and adopted China-theatre directional values remain project decisions; their source status is preserved.
Special routes and geographic rule references do not implement runtime permissions, combat or scenario setup.
_meta.unknown_values: null means not source-reviewed; false means an authored negative or a retained legacy value whose review status is in the sidecar.
_meta.current_owner_semantics: Legacy setup hint only; original_owner is static identity. Neither current_owner nor is_capital is runtime state.
_meta.rail_semantics: Land-border railway_connection describes printed rail. Legacy coast railway_connection artwork is retained pending AM-229 and grants no rail movement into a sea. printed_rail_coverage is true when a land-border railroad establishes coverage, otherwise unknown. Gauge changes require verified gauges on both sides, never ownership.

feature_uncertainties.rail_region_membership: The rulebook capacity table names seven regions but audited territory memberships are not complete. Do not infer from current control.
feature_uncertainties.narrow_crossing_naval_paths: Blocking seas are known where recorded; exact naval transit and facility access intersections are not yet fully traced.
feature_uncertainties.river_routes: Deferred with AP-086. A combat river crossing is not a navigable river network.
